verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing showing that BigQuery, or its Gemini and conversational-analytics agents, can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The only MCP evidence is MCP Toolbox for Databases, which is an MCP server that exposes databases to agents. That is the opposite role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Because BigQuery ships agentic AI features, the question is a fair one for this product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
